g.text: How much does the cancellation example matter?
Forty streams per condition; 95% Wilson intervals. Only the full swap preserves aggregate and single-attribute input distributions exactly.
Aggregate alerts there are false alarms. Points are offset horizontally to expose overlap; lines only guide the eye.
